effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Main] If you have a Digimon with [Justimon] or [Raidenmon] in its name in play, you may pay 1 memory to place this card under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
[When Digivolving] You may trash 1 Digimon card with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait in your hand to place 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to its owner's hand.
